name: Omatree
author: Tiedeyez
description: Omatree — a living bonsai in a glass house on your bar, grown from a seed unique to this machine. Plant it from seed or from a cutting, water and feed it, and prune it by hand into your own shape. It ages with your system and you. No two are ever alike.

barWidget.description: Your companion bonsai, living in the bar. Click to open its glass house.
